title: Has anyone been to this city?
content: Years ago I had a dream where I was flying into a city, it was beautiful and bright, architecture very opulent. There’s people walking the streets and they look like they could be in Victorian style clothing. But it’s pleasant and a nice day out. I find myself on the street and follow a friend down a set of stone stairs, they curve as we go down. At the bottom is an old fortune telling machine, and I wish I could remember the fortune it gave me. Going past the stairs open up into a giant cathedral like structure, it’s round and has a dome like might be found in the Vatican, covered in beautiful paintings. The hall is full of long wooden tables, heaped with random objects, all kinda of things, and there’s people milling around. A woman asks me if I can help her find her missing violin, and tells me that this place is where people find things they lost. Maybe a decade after this dream I met a guy who told me about a dream he had, and it was identical, right down to the tables and lost objects, and I’ve wondered ever since I’d this was a shared space. I visited the city one other time, and it was at night and not the friends and warm place I’d known in daylight. Someone tried to make me rid their attic of a monster and I suddenly decided that I had no responsibility to clean out their house and left, wandering. I found a little warm looking shop and an older, maybe Asian man let me inside and explained that he has the way out and showed me to a big round door. Going through it woke me up. My whole life I’ve wondered if any others than the guy I met have also been to this place, and what city it may be.
